summary: The terminal window title feature is implemented but unverified: I did not run the tests or Black, per your instructions. Changes: added SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 to ControlType (rich/segment.py); added the title escape-sequence format entry and Control.title(title) classmethod (rich/control.py); added Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool, gated on is_terminal like show_cursor (rich/console.py); added a SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch calling term.set_title(title) in the legacy renderer (rich/_windows_renderer.py); added an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200 (CHANGELOG.md). Added three tests: test_set_window_title (console, skipped on win32), test_control_title (control), and test_control_set_window_title (Windows-only renderer). Nothing was committed. Interpretation: workflow 1 was read as gating on is_terminal like show_cursor, since existing _render_buffer already drops control segments when not a terminal.
